# logic constraint member

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/logicConstraintMember>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A member constraint combined by a logical constraint ([odrl:operand](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/operand)). Non-functional: a logical constraint combines two or more.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to add a member constraint to a boolean combination (the [odrl:operand](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/operand)) — each member is itself a [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) or a nested [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to condition a rule (that is [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](gmeow-ruleConstraint.md)) and avoid a single-member logical constraint; a combination has two or more members.

### How to use

- Add two or more [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) links from a [`LogicalConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md) to its parts (non-functional), under a single [`gmeow:constraintLogic`](gmeow-constraintLogic.md) operator.

### Examples

- ex:euAndUntil2030 [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md) ex:inEu, ex:until2030.
